props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the Sheet asks to open or close, when the pane takes over an open Sheet's item, and when the root stops splitting with focus inside the pane, which opens the Sheet. A change of layout, from the root's width, the root font size or `split`, keeps focus where the user was. Losing the split with focus inside the pane opens the Sheet, which takes focus. With focus elsewhere the list keeps it. Gaining the split with focus inside the Sheet moves focus to the pane, after any menu or dialog open in the Sheet has closed. A Sheet that opened because the root narrowed returns focus, when it closes, to the list item that last held focus.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the detail Sheet is open. The app holds the selected item, and `open` says only whether its Sheet is open. Set it when the user opens an item, and follow `onOpenChange`. From the breakpoint the pane shows the item instead, so the root answers an `open` there with `onOpenChange(false)`, and the Sheet stays closed until the root narrows with focus in the pane.

props.name: split
props.description: The root width from which the detail is a complementary pane beside the list. Below it, the detail opens in a Sheet over the list. The breakpoint is a container query on the root, so it follows the room the root has: a Sidebar opening beside it narrows it as a smaller window does. The root takes its width from its parent. The server renders the split layout, and CSS hides the pane in a root narrower than the breakpoint, so the first paint matches before any script runs. Pass `never` to keep the detail in a Sheet at every width, for a list that needs all of its width, such as a wide table.
